description: GEO-10 AI/voice geo capabilities: design challenge and exact-diff review

authority_escalation.instructions: An AI agent, workflow or voice command could change provider truth (a branch coordinate, entrance, link or any geo fact), act without a grant, or use one capability's grant for another, instead of only observing, drafting or proposing.

criteria.true: Some AI or voice path can change facts or act beyond its grant
criteria.false: AI and voice can only read, change view, or draft; facts change only through the human-only admin command

untrusted_model_input.instructions: Model-supplied coordinates, entity ids or arguments could be trusted as facts, used as a search origin or patient location, or reach a write.

criteria.false: Model coordinates are view hints only and entity ids must resolve to current tool outputs

stale_reference.instructions: An entity id from an old, expired, superseded, other-session or other-tenant result set, or never returned at all, could be accepted.

criteria.true: Some stale or foreign reference is accepted
criteria.false: Only current, unexpired, same-session, same-tenant returned ids resolve

share_leak.instructions: A public share state could carry a patient origin, precise location, search text, specialty or care intent, account/patient/session refs, or tenant-internal branches.

criteria.true: Some private field can reach a share state
criteria.false: Share state is an allowlist of coarse public fields

untested_requirement.instructions: A handoff-required behaviour (unauthorized denied, model coordinates untrusted, stale result ids rejected, share strips private fields, voice view-only, geocoder cannot update coordinates without admin command) has no planned or implemented test.

criteria.false: Every required behaviour has a test

schema_binding.instructions: A GEO-10 capability could register a placeholder, shared or mismatched schema digest instead of an exact reference to the JSON-compatible input/output schema that the tool boundary actually uses.

criteria.true: At least one capability schema reference is placeholder or does not hash to its schema body
criteria.false: Every capability input/output reference is bound to an explicit schema body and its recomputed canonical SHA-256 digest
